snippet.title: MudRunner - PS5 & XBOX Series Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The truck sim legend is back. 🚛

We're thrilled to announce that MudRunner is now available on Gen 9 consoles!
Time to discover (or rediscover) the game that started it all on PS5 and XBOX Series X|S: https://tinyurl.com/mudrunner-gen9
